```{r message = FALSE}

library(StrathE2E2)
model <- e2e_read("North_Sea", "1970-1999")
results <- e2e_run(model,nyears=15)

```

```{r}

harvest_ratio_data <- e2e_extract_hr(model,results)

print(harvest_ratio_data$Whole_domain_harvest_ratio)

```

```{r results='hide'}

Activity <- model$data$fleet.model$gear_activity
Power <- model$data$fleet.model$gear_group_rel_power

HR = Power * Activity


if_single_value <- function(guild) {
  if (sum( guild != 0) == 1 ) {
  which( guild != 0 )
} else {
  print("FALSE")
}
}

col_num <- 8
if_single_value(HR[, col_num])

```
